# Small deterministic score fixtures

- `piano-basic.musicxml`: explicit F-sharp/F-natural pitches, chord, rest, backup voice, bass staff, implicit pickup bars; 6 notes, 2.5 seconds.
- `piano-basic.mxl`: compressed version of that score with `META-INF/container.xml` pointing to its main document.
- `tempo-tie.musicxml`: quarter tempo 120 → 60, tie across the pickup boundary and trailing rest; C4 lasts 1.5 seconds, E4 starts at 1.5 seconds; total 3.5 seconds.
- `tuplets-metronome.musicxml`: dotted-quarter=60 (quarter=90), three explicit one-third-quarter notes and a simultaneous bass part.
- `unsupported.musicxml`: repeat, grace and dynamics; the parser must display limitations.
- `piano-tempo.mid`: hand-authored format-1 SMF, PPQ 480; tempo changes after tick 480; Right, Left and percussion tracks. Pitched result: C3 at 0 for 1.5s, C4 at 0 for 0.5s, E4/G4 at 0.5 for 1s. Percussion is skipped with a warning.
- `short-note.mid`: one tick at PPQ 480 and default 120 BPM, velocity 1/127. It must not be stretched to a 10ms note.
- `synthetic-test.sf2`, `synthetic-test.dls`: original mathematical sine-wave samples, generated by `scripts/create-test-assets.mjs`, solely for exercising local loading/routing/persistence. No third-party recordings are used. They are not realistic piano soundfonts and are not bundled with the app.
